# Engine-owned pin header action collapses a pane to its edge rail

## Context

Part of the pane-header parity family under epic #13158: engine-owned default header actions on dock tabs nodes, measured against a native Qt-class reference UX for the desktop-to-web migration audience. `#17928` (maximize) is the intake-validated sibling. The family freezes one ordering contract, stated here once and shared by every leaf: **[tab overflow, only while overflowing] → [host actions] → [engine set: lock · reload · pin · pop-out · maximize — focus-gated via the tab header's `showOnFocus` default] → [close — always visible, always last]**. Every engine action ships behind its own `enableDock<X>Action` boolean (the `close` precedent) with the adapter's reserved-name guard extended to it. Anchors verified at Engine `dev@34499f737b`.

## The Problem

ADR 0029 §2.7's interaction contract specifies a **"Collapse control on a pinned/visible pane"**: a two-step sequence through the reducer — `setItemPinned(itemId, false)` (when pinned) then `setItemAutoHidden(itemId, true)` — with each step committing independently and no composite operation. That row was specified as implementation-sufficient, but it has no implementation: #13280 (closed) and PR #13770 landed the *other* direction — rails project committed-auto-hidden items, the reveal overlay's pin control commits `setItemPinned(true)` (`src/dashboard/dock/interaction/Rail.mjs:423-453`, `RevealOverlay.mjs:30`).

The only non-model caller of `setItemAutoHidden` in the tree is persistence's `RestorePlanner` (`src/dashboard/dock/persistence/RestorePlanner.mjs:123`). A user can bring a pane back **from** the rail, but no affordance sends one **to** the rail. The round-trip is half-built.

## The Architectural Reality

- **Action substrate (shipped):** the adapter projects engine-owned actions with a reserved-name guard and host actions preceding them (`src/dashboard/dock/projection/LayoutAdapter.mjs:958-1002`); the Workspace owns intent dispatch (`Workspace.mjs:1250 onDockHeaderAction`) and per-active-item policy by moving `hidden` on one stable action instance (`Workspace.mjs:1164 syncDockCloseAction`), never by list replacement — the discipline `actionVisibilityChange` consumers (tab Overflow) depend on.
- **Focus gating (shipped):** `toolbar.Base` gates actions on `showOnFocus` through a `containsFocus` subscription (`src/toolbar/Base.mjs:255-301`); the tab header's default gates everything the leaf does not exempt.
- **Model guards (shipped):** `setItemAutoHidden` rejects non-boolean payloads, `pinnable === false` items, and (per §2.7's state table) detached items; `setItemPinned(true)` clears `autoHidden` (`src/dashboard/dock/model/Operations.mjs:368-408`).
- **Edge derivation (binding):** §2.7 — "the rail an item collapses to is the edge zone that contains it"; center-zone items never rail (fail-safe: main content does not auto-hide). The action is therefore only *meaningful* for items owned by an edge zone.

## The Fix

`enableDockPinAction: false` on `dashboard.dock.Workspace`. When on:

- The adapter projects a `pin` action into the engine set at its frozen slot; the reserved-name guard covers `pin` like `close`.
- The Workspace owns dispatch: for the active item, commit §2.7's two-step collapse sequence through `applyDockZoneOperation` — each step independent, the intermediate state (unpinned, visible) benign per the ADR row.
- Visibility policy via the `syncDockCloseAction` idiom, recomputed on `onDockActiveIndexChange` (`LayoutAdapter.mjs:418`): **hidden** while the active item is not edge-zone-owned or is `pinnable: false` — the action never renders where the gesture cannot complete.
- The restore direction stays the shipped overlay pin control; this leaf adds no second path back.

## Decision Record impact

`aligned-with ADR 0029 §2.7` — implements its specified-but-unbuilt interaction row. No new operations, no schema change, no composite op (the row forbids one).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `enableDockPinAction: false` leaves every current consumer's projection byte-identical; `true` renders the focus-gated `pin` toggle at the frozen engine-set slot, reserved-name guard covering `pin`.
- [ ] Pressing pin on an edge-zone-owned, pinnable active pane commits the §2.7 two-step sequence (both operations witnessed in order, independently committed) and the item rails on its owning edge.
- [ ] The action is hidden while the active item is center-zone-owned or `pinnable: false` (witnessed via active-item switch), and visibility moves by `hidden` on one stable instance — `actionVisibilityChange` fires, the action group is never replaced.
- [ ] Round-trip e2e gesture spec in the same PR (epic gesture-proof guardrail): pin → rail tab appears → reveal → overlay pin control returns the pane to the tab flow.
- [ ] A perspective captured before/after merely *rendering* the action is byte-identical; only the committed `pinned`/`autoHidden` fields change when the gesture runs (existing serialization rules).

## Out of Scope

- Hover-reveal defaults, rail drag, overlay behavior — shipped by #13280 per §2.7; untouched.
- A composite pin/auto-hide operation — §2.7 explicitly rejects one.
- The sibling actions (lock, reload, pop-out, maximize) — their own leaves.

## Related

Parent: #13158. Siblings: #17928 (maximize, validated), reload / pop-out / lock / overflow-as-action leaves filed alongside this one. Predecessors: #13280, PR #13770, PR #15474. Authority: ADR 0029 §2.7 (`learn/agentos/decisions/0029-docking-design.md`).
